sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/louisville.json: read. Maps results are mostly remodelers, plumbers and stores; only D.A.W. Company was relevant. Web seed URLs are Google redirect links with no domains.
Bobrick Find a Rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded, but the rep dropdown and results didn't render, so no KY reps were readable.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked, but it lists only regional product specialists (KY covered from an out-of-state territory rep), no local dealers.
Bradley, Metpar, Ampco/Ammco locators: not reached (budget).

Procore Network public pages: worked. The KY door-hardware and KY compartments-and-cubicles categories surfaced Atlas, US Specialties, Schiller and MiD. The Louisville toilet-compartments filter showed unrelated firms. Baylor Commercial Door (Corbin, KY), Accurate Door & Hardware (Paducah) and CHOSEN Commercial Contract (Erlanger) list toilet compartments but are well outside 30 miles.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. Generic searches mostly returned national online sellers (One Point Partitions, toiletpartitions.com, Prestige, Newton) and residential plumbers. The door hardware plus Division 10 search was the most productive.
Superpages Louisville toilet-partitions page: worked. It confirmed D.A.W. and showed WireCrafters, Dant Clayton and Vanderbur, which are manufacturers or industrial firms and were skipped.
Kelley Bros locations: worked. No KY or southern Indiana office (nearest are Indianapolis and Mason, OH), so it was skipped.
One Point Partitions Louisville page: 403. It is a national online seller with a delivery terminal, so it was skipped.
Yelp and BBB: none surfaced in searches.

candidates.name: The Atlas Companies (Atlas Co.)
brands: Scranton Products (Hiny Hiders, per Scranton case study)
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10 page lists 'toilet compartments and accessories' and says Atlas supplies and installs most items listed; Scranton Products case study says Atlas Co. sourced the Hiny Hiders partitions for the KFC Yum! Center (the installer isn't named).
red_flags: Large Division 8/10/12 distributor-contractor, mostly bid work; installation of partitions stated generally, not shown project by project
candidates.reason: Louisville commercial Division 10 contractor that lists toilet compartments among the items it supplies and installs, and supplied the Yum! Center partitions. It also sells partitions, so the listing agreement terms matter.

license.name: The Atlas Companies (Atlas Co.)
license.registry: Louisville Metro Construction Review (Develop Louisville) contractor identification licenses; open-data snapshot 'Louisville Metro KY - Active Contractors' (LOJIC)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Kentucky has no state license for this work; Louisville Metro requires a building contractor identification. No current official online lookup found: louisvilleky.gov returned 403 to automated access. The only public dataset (LOJIC open data, last updated 2022-06-19 per data.gov, licence expirations 2015-2020) has no 'Atlas Companies'/'Atlas Co.' record (only an unrelated 'Atlas Siding & Window Co.'). The dataset is stale, so absence proves nothing. Confirm with Construction Review by phone or email.
